def transform(grid):
    """Continue a diagonal arithmetic sequence with color 2."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    dr = points[-1][0] - points[-2][0]
    dc = points[-1][1] - points[-2][1]
    if dr <= 0 or dc <= 0:
        return out
    r, c = points[-1]
    h, w = len(out), len(out[0])
    r += dr
    c += dc
    while r < h and c < w:
        out[r][c] = 2
        r += dr
        c += dc
    return out

 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Extend the diagonal sequence of 1s with 2s at the same interval."""
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 1]
    points.sort()
    if len(points) < 2:
        return out
    dr = points[-1][0] - points[-2][0]
    dc = points[-1][1] - points[-2][1]
    if dr <= 0 or dc <= 0:
        return out
    r, c = points[-1]
    height, width = len(out), len(out[0])
    r += dr
    c += dc
    while r < height and c < width:
        out[r][c] = 2
        r += dr
        c += dc
    return out
